the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: By the carried pull diagram (equation-pull) the two top rows R x_{t,U,t} R to R and R x_{s,U,t} R to R are isomorphic via the displayed vertical maps, so the composition c : R x_{s,U,t} R to R is isomorphic to the projection pr_1 : R x_{t,U,t} R to R. The projection R x_{t,U,t} R to R is a morphism with target the spectrum of a field, hence open by Morphisms, scheme-over-field-universally-open. Openness is preserved under isomorphism, so c is open. (source lines 1161-1167)
